name: 置顶与拖拽约束
desc: 列表行可置顶（置顶项排在列表最前、左侧有 pinned 竖条、按钮图标变 mdi:pin / 文案变「取消置顶」）；置顶项只能在置顶项之间拖拽换位、普通项只能在普通项之间（跨区拖拽时落点线被夹回同类区间，松手不会跨区）；取消置顶；刷新后置顶状态与顺序都落盘

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); sessionStorage.setItem('__todo_store_id', JSON.stringify({ id: 'conjure-todo-app-test', exp: Date.now() + 600000 })); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); return T.click(Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === t)); }; T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.setVal = (el, v) => { if (!el) throw new Error('输入元素不存在'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.addTask = async (title, desc) => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-field'), desc ? title + T.NL + desc : title); await T.wait(250); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(400); return true; }; T.items = () => T.q('.list .item'); T.titles = () => T.items().map((i) => T.tx(i.querySelector('.text'))); T.need = (t) => { const i = T.items().find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.text')) === t); if (!i) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + t); return i; }; T.pinBtn = (t) => { const b = T.need(t).querySelector('.pin-btn'); if (!b) throw new Error('行尾找不到置顶按钮：' + t); return b; }; T.pin = (t) => T.click(T.pinBtn(t)); T.hold = async (fromTitle, toTitle, where) => { const a = T.need(fromTitle); const b = T.need(toTitle); const h = a.querySelector('.drag-handle'); const hr = h.getBoundingClientRect(); const mk = (ev, x, y) => new PointerEvent(ev, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', clientX: x, clientY: y }); h.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown', hr.left + 5, hr.top + 5)); await T.wait(200); const tr = b.getBoundingClientRect(); const y = where === 'after' ? tr.bottom - 2 : tr.top + 2; window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove', tr.left + 40, y)); await T.wait(250); return true; }; T.release = async () => { window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', clientX: 0, clientY: 0 })); await T.wait(500); return true; }; T.drag = async (a, b, w) => { await T.hold(a, b, w); return await T.release(); }; T.dropCls = (t) => { const c = T.need(t).className; return c.indexOf('drop-before') !== -1 ? 'before' : c.indexOf('drop-after') !== -1 ? 'after' : ''; }; return 'helpers ready';

await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); await T.addTask('A', ''); await T.addTask('B', ''); await T.addTask('C', ''); await T.addTask('D', ''); if (T.titles().join(',') !== 'D,C,B,A') throw new Error('初始顺序不正确：' + T.titles()); if (T.q('.item.pinned').length !== 0) throw new Error('初始不应有置顶项'); const b = T.pinBtn('B'); if (b.querySelector('n-icon').getAttribute('icon') !== 'mdi:pin-outline') throw new Error('未置顶时图标应为 mdi:pin-outline'); if (b.getAttribute('title').indexOf('置顶') !== 0) throw new Error('按钮 title 不正确：' + b.getAttribute('title')); return 'ok';

T.pin('B'); await T.wait(450); if (T.titles().join(',') !== 'B,D,C,A') throw new Error('置顶后应排到列表最前且普通项顺序不变，实际 ' + T.titles()); const i = T.need('B'); if (i.className.indexOf('pinned') === -1) throw new Error('置顶行应带 pinned 类：' + i.className); if (i.getBoundingClientRect().height <= 0) throw new Error('置顶行应有正常高度'); const pb = T.pinBtn('B'); if (pb.querySelector('n-icon').getAttribute('icon') !== 'mdi:pin') throw new Error('已置顶时图标应为 mdi:pin'); if (pb.getAttribute('title') !== '取消置顶') throw new Error('已置顶时 title 应为「取消置顶」，实际 ' + pb.getAttribute('title')); if (T.q('.item.pinned').length !== 1) throw new Error('应有 1 条置顶项，实际 ' + T.q('.item.pinned').length); return 'ok';

T.pin('C'); await T.wait(450); if (T.titles().join(',') !== 'C,B,D,A') throw new Error('第二条置顶应排在置顶区最前，实际 ' + T.titles()); if (T.q('.item.pinned').length !== 2) throw new Error('应有 2 条置顶项'); await T.drag('C', 'B', 'after'); if (T.titles().join(',') !== 'B,C,D,A') throw new Error('置顶区内应能换位（C 移到 B 之后），实际 ' + T.titles()); await T.drag('C', 'B', 'before'); if (T.titles().join(',') !== 'C,B,D,A') throw new Error('置顶区内应能换回（C 移到 B 之前），实际 ' + T.titles()); return 'ok';

await T.hold('C', 'D', 'before'); const onB = T.dropCls('B'); const onD = T.dropCls('D'); const onA = T.dropCls('A'); if (onB !== 'after') throw new Error('拖置顶项到普通区时，落点线应被夹回置顶区最后一行（B 应为 drop-after），实际 B=' + onB + ' D=' + onD); if (onD || onA) throw new Error('落点线不应画在普通区行上：D=' + onD + ' A=' + onA); const pinned = T.q('.item.pinned').map((i) => T.tx(i.querySelector('.text'))); if (pinned.join(',') !== 'C,B') throw new Error('拖动中不应改变置顶状态：' + pinned.join(',')); await T.release(); if (T.titles().join(',') !== 'B,C,D,A') throw new Error('置顶项跨区拖拽后仍应停在置顶区（只能在置顶项之间换位），实际 ' + T.titles()); if (T.q('.item.pinned').length !== 2) throw new Error('置顶项数量不应变化'); return 'ok';

await T.hold('A', 'C', 'before'); const onC = T.dropCls('C'); const onB = T.dropCls('B'); const onD = T.dropCls('D'); if (onC || onB) throw new Error('普通项拖到置顶区时落点线不应画在置顶行上：C=' + onC + ' B=' + onB); if (onD !== 'before') throw new Error('落点线应夹到普通区第一行（D），实际 D=' + onD); await T.release(); if (T.titles().join(',') !== 'B,C,A,D') throw new Error('普通项只应在普通区内换位（A 到普通区最前），实际 ' + T.titles()); const a = T.need('A'); if (a.className.indexOf('pinned') !== -1) throw new Error('普通项拖拽不应变成置顶项'); if (T.q('.item.pinned').map((i) => T.tx(i.querySelector('.text'))).join(',') !== 'B,C') throw new Error('置顶区顺序不应被打乱'); return 'ok';

T.pin('B'); await T.wait(450); if (T.titles().join(',') !== 'C,B,A,D') throw new Error('取消置顶后应落到普通区最前（紧跟置顶区），实际 ' + T.titles()); if (T.need('B').className.indexOf('pinned') !== -1) throw new Error('取消置顶后不应再有 pinned 类'); if (T.q('.item.pinned').length !== 1) throw new Error('应剩 1 条置顶项'); if (T.need('B').querySelector('.pin-btn').getAttribute('title').indexOf('置顶') !== 0) throw new Error('取消置顶后按钮 title 应回到「置顶…」'); return 'ok';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.list .item')); const titles = items.map((i) => i.querySelector('.text').textContent.trim()); if (titles.join(',') !== 'C,B,A,D') throw new Error('刷新后顺序应保持：' + titles.join(',')); if (root.querySelectorAll('.item.pinned').length !== 1) throw new Error('刷新后应有 1 条置顶项，实际 ' + root.querySelectorAll('.item.pinned').length); if (items[0].querySelector('.text').textContent.trim() !== 'C') throw new Error('刷新后置顶项应仍在最前'); if (root.querySelectorAll('.item.dragging').length || root.querySelectorAll('.item.drop-before').length || root.querySelectorAll('.item.drop-after').length) throw new Error('刷新后不应残留拖拽视觉态'); return 'ok';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); sessionStorage.removeItem('__todo_store_id'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
